Hi Samir —

Thanks again for taking the time today to walk through FinPath's use cases. Quick recap from my side:
- Primary goal: reduce inference latency for real-time assistant features while keeping monthly cost predictable.
- Main workloads: chat generation (short responses, high QPS) and embeddings for semantic search.
- Success criteria: <=150ms p95 on the assistant route and <30% increase in unit cost vs baseline.

Next recommended step: schedule a 45-60m technical deep dive (Neha, our Sales Engineer, + one of our platform engineers) to:
1) deep-dive on traffic patterns and sample prompts
2) review model/quantization tradeoffs and expected latencies
3) surface any security/procurement asks up-front so we can scope an implementation timeline

Proposed times (PT):
- Mon 19 Jan, 10:00-11:00am
- Tue 20 Jan, 2:00-3:00pm
- Wed 21 Jan, 11:30-12:30pm

If you can share the right contacts for security and procurement, I can loop them in and include a short agenda + SOC2 checklist. Attaching a quick agenda and our SOC2 questionnaire so your team can review ahead of time.

Attachments: redwood-technical-deep-dive-agenda.pdf; SOC2-ask.pdf

Thanks - looking forward to next steps.

Best,
